Daily Wear Collection

Not every piece of gold needs to be reserved for special occasions. Our Daily Wear Collection features lightweight gold bangles, gold earrings in the latest earrings design, gold bracelets and gold chain designs for comfort and everyday elegance, without compromising on purity from a classic kara bangle to a modern gold pendant design.

These pieces are priced to be accessible while still carrying our full purity guarantee including 22K gold bangles, gold stud earrings, long earrings designs, gold locket designsand emerald-set gold bracelets for those who want a pop of colour so you can enjoy real gold every day.

  • Lightweight designs comfortable for everyday use
  • Affordable pricing on smaller-weight pieces
  • Latest design updates added regularly
  • Full purity certification, just like our bridal pieces
